risks: num_workers=0: the data loader runs in the training process, so the GPU waits on it
Trains for 25 epochs, so every document repeats 25 times; repeated low-quality data costs more than unique data (give per-document quality scores for the repetition view)
Full-batch training moves entire graph to one device which can run out of memory.
Test accuracy is computed every epoch which adds overhead.
Provided partial map pointed to wrong files and wrong loop kind and has been replaced.
